# Known flaky tests that the CI gate (scripts/ci-gate.py) reruns once, the exception the
# project's rules make: "a single known flake that already has a fix in progress". A
# flaky test is a bug. An entry needs an open issue with the fix on its way; once the
# issue closes, the entry no longer counts, and the line goes in the pull request that
# fixes it.
#
# ISSUE  TEST NAME (a Python regular expression, matched against the whole name libtest
#        prints under "failures:")
